description: This file contains mock implementations and test helpers for the openclaw gateway project, including stub functions for channels, speech providers, plugin registry, configuration, and various mocked modules for testing purposes.

methods.name: buildBundledPluginModuleId
methods.description: Constructs a module ID path for a plugin extension based on plugin ID and artifact basename.

methods.name: createStubOutboundAdapter
methods.description: Creates a stub outbound adapter for a given channel ID.

methods.name: createStubChannelPlugin
methods.description: Creates a stub channel plugin with specified options.

methods.name: createStubSpeechProvider
methods.description: Creates a stub speech provider with specified options.

methods.name: createStubPluginRegistry
methods.description: Creates a stub plugin registry with predefined channels and providers.

methods.name: createEmbeddedRunMockExports
methods.description: Provides mock implementations for embedded run control functions.

methods.name: importEmbeddedRunMockModule
methods.description: Imports a module and extends it with embedded run mock functions.
